clayresearch.summary: Treat the complete FRANK invention/failure lineage as an active mechanism library. Integrate surviving mechanisms by causal function rather than biological/service names, and keep failure-derived invariants first-class.
clayresearch.next_experiment: Search for the smallest coupled semantic basis that reproduces Workspace+Thalamus+Memory+Personality behavior while preserving all historical failure discriminators.

frank.summary: Use C9 as explicit base plus lineage-fused overlay. Preserve conceptual organs and lesion points while collapsing accidental service/process boundaries. Global Workspace and Thalamus now have mandatory historical regression matrices.
frank.next_experiment: Build an executable reference trace for event->Amygdala->Thalamus->required context->GWT->reader->outcome->reentry including visual familiar/novel/conflict arms.

gwt.summary: Workspace lineage proves that INNER_WORLD projector, pub/sub bus and competition/ignition stage are distinct. GWT contracts must detect producer-without-consumer, bus-without-competition and selection-without-causal-use fractures.
gwt.next_experiment: Golden lineage mutants: delete projector consumer, replace competition with broadcast-all, stale 60s workspace, decouple winner from reader, and require each failure be detected.

emergenz.summary: Historical library-walk, AURA recurrence and shared-state loops become prospective causal experiment seeds only. Shared ancestry, designer mappings and recurrence receive no independent emergence credit.
emergenz.next_experiment: Recreate historical shared-state cases under lesions, shuffled state, common-driver controls and rescue with frozen model fixtures.

claycode.summary: BASE must encode the surviving historical organ semantics and regression states without adding a primitive merely because an old service existed. Required constructs include multi-rate state, named channels, epoch/version aliases, explicit UNKNOWN, effect intent/permit separation and atomic publication.
claycode.next_experiment: Compile one lineage stress program covering Thalamus gain/relay, GWT stages, renamed channel migration, stale projection, crash/replay and protected effect permit using existing language semantics.

hyperposition.summary: Use historical cross-organ couplings as topology candidates, especially Thalamus<->GWT, E-PQ<->reward/conflict, memory<->perception and workspace<->reentry. Preserve direct, shared-driver, derived and historical-alias edges separately.
hyperposition.next_experiment: Construct topology twins from the historical organ graph and test which couplings survive edge lesions and physical module collapse.

claygraph.summary: Represent organ/version lineage, renames, supersession, failure edges and current semantic successors explicitly. Historical aliases such as AURA->Swarm and Titan->LCME cannot create duplicate current entities/evidence.
claygraph.next_experiment: Build a lineage graph differential fixture where renames, deletions and successor merges preserve provenance without stale CURRENT edges.

unifieddb.summary: Persist organ state by semantic identity/version rather than service/file identity. Migration, restart and current-state publication must prevent stale singleton overwrites, schema-position reuse and derived-edge survival after source removal.
unifieddb.next_experiment: Replay historical schema migrations (Entity->Room, AURA->Swarm, Titan->LCME, context/action dimensions) across crash-mid-migration and verify one coherent CURRENT epoch.

harness.summary: Convert historical bugs into executable anti-regression families. Priority: Workspace deletion fracture, Thalamus gain/relay decoupling, stale architecture prompt fact, destructive skip-approval, E-PQ stale singleton, NAc inverted habituation, Conscience positive-only rubber stamp, memory orphan/stale edge and SOMA concurrency/rollback.
harness.next_experiment: Materialize these failures as H1 Golden Mutants after BASE; ensure H2/H3 detect the same failures representation-independently.

anti_echo: Historical versions, renamed services and related FRANK variants share ancestry unless proven otherwise; repeated mechanisms receive provenance but no independent replication bonus.
